hero.title: Give every AI agent a computer built for the task.
hero.description: Double Agent turns your Linux server into secure, disposable workstations with CPU, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Linux, Windows, Blender, browsers, and development tools.

capabilities.title: From intent to verified artifacts
capabilities.imagesBody: Schedule a proven GPU backend and preserve prompts, seeds, models, and hashes.
capabilities.blenderBody: Run Blender headlessly or open a temporary desktop, then export GLB, FBX, and previews.
capabilities.testBody: Create clean Linux or Windows environments and return reports, binaries, and logs.
capabilities.browseBody: Run isolated browser workflows with authenticated viewing and controlled downloads.

architecture.title: The client reasons. The server executes.
architecture.body: Use Double Agent as a pure executor, delegate an objective to its optional internal AI, or combine both approaches.
architecture.step1Body: The client finds proven capabilities over MCP.
architecture.step2Body: The scheduler selects a container, VM, CPU, or GPU.
architecture.step3Body: The isolated environment performs the work.
architecture.step4Body: The agent receives verified artifacts and metadata.
architecture.step5Body: Resources are released; only approved results remain.

security.eyebrow: POWERFUL INSIDE, ISOLATED FROM THE HOST
security.title: Root in the instance is not root on the server.
security.body: Runtime sockets, host files, unassigned devices, raw secrets, and other users' workloads stay outside the agent boundary.

footer.status: Architecture preview · Not yet production software
footer.language: English is canonical. Human-facing surfaces are multilingual.
